description: 用 I will … / We will … 说出周末打算做的事。
mastery_criteria: 能选出正确的 will 计划句

diagnostic_question.question: 想说「我们周末将去野餐」，应选哪一句？
diagnostic_question.answer: We will have a picnic this weekend.

description: 综合用 What will you do …? / Let's … 讨论一个精彩的周末计划。

diagnostic_question.question: 想问「你周末将做什么？」，应选哪一句？
diagnostic_question.answer: What will you do this weekend?
